scenes.name: Вход в зоопарк
scenes.composition: arch on the upper third, Alatau peaks behind, kids on the lower third (Aisha left, Arman right), path leads the eye to the gate
scenes.speaker: aisha

line.kz: Сәлем, Арман! Қарашы, біз Алматы хайуанаттар бағына келдік!
line.pl: Cześć, Arman! Spójrz, przyszliśmy do almatyńskiego zoo!

scenes.name: Қар барысы мен арыстан
scenes.composition: rocky enclosure top-left (snow leopard on a ledge), savanna bottom-right (lion), Arman in the lower-left corner pointing
animation: cards pop with spring, pointer lines draw (strokeDashoffset)
scenes.speaker: arman

line.kz: Керемет! Анау жерде қар барысы мен арыстан жүр!
line.pl: Super! Tam spacerują pantera śnieżna i lew!

scenes.name: Керік пен піл
scenes.camera: tilt up the giraffe's neck, then settle
scenes.composition: giraffe on the left reaching a tree crown at the top, elephant on the right raising the trunk, Aisha bottom-centre looking up
scenes.speaker: aisha

line.kz: Ал мына керік сондай биік! Қасында үлкен піл тұр.
line.pl: A ta żyrafa jest taka wysoka! Obok stoi wielki słoń.

scenes.name: Құндыздың тоғаны
scenes.camera: gentle pan right to the pond, 1.0 → 1.08
scenes.composition: pond fills the lower half, wooden dam on the right, beaver on a log at the centre, Arman on the bank bottom-left
animation: beaver blinks, nose twitches, teeth shine
big call-out card with a long pointer
scenes.speaker: arman

line.kz: Ой, тоғанға қара! Бұл нағыз құндыз — Бобер!
line.pl: Ojej, spójrz na staw! To prawdziwy bóbr — Bober!

scenes.name: Бобер сәлем береді
scenes.camera: push-in on the beaver 1.05 → 1.15, small shake on the tail slap
scenes.composition: beaver large at the centre, kids laughing at the bottom corners, summary plate at the bottom
animation: tail slaps the water, vector splash drops
scenes.speaker: aisha

line.kz: Ол өте сүйкімді! Бүгінгі серуен өте қызықты өтті!
line.pl: Jest taki uroczy! Dzisiejszy spacer był bardzo ciekawy!

scenes.name: Outro / CTA
scenes.composition: title on top, snow-leopard cub mascot on a rotating stylised globe, flag clouds 🇰🇿 🇵🇱, books, a cup, Almaty mountains, glossy button at the bottom
